name: tool-versioning
title: Tool versioning
description: For tool repos (libraries, instruments, bridges) whose output other people's research consumes: one version, output-changing releases named in the changelog, consumers listed, and release-check. Installs alongside prereg.
notes: For a repo that is a tool: it holds no experiments, except comparison units under sims/ and datasets/ that compare the tool with other tools (TOOL_VERSIONING.md §1a). Before tagging a release, and in CI, run: python3 .agents/tools/release-check
